description: We’re a team of curious students passionate about technology, AI, space, and solving real-world problems. We love learning, building, and turning creative ideas into impactful solutions. We’re looking for enthusiastic teammates skilled in Python, AI/ML, web development, data visualization, UI/UX, or astronomy. Most importantly, we value creativity, collaboration, and a willingness to learn. Join us to explore new frontiers and build something out of this world!
